character: A southern Vermont resort in the Deerfield Valley, operated by Vail Resorts, and one of the closest large Vermont ski areas to the New York and Boston metro areas. Its separate Carinthia base focuses on terrain parks.
learning: Reference note: ski school and rentals operate at the Main Base. Learning-area details were not researched — confirm at source.

season.notes: Not researched in this build (web-search budget exhausted). No 2026-27 opening or closing date is on file as of 2026-09-28 — check the official site. Past opening dates were not captured, so no estimated window is derived.

driveFromIthaca.basis: Estimate from typical routing (NY-79/I-88 to Albany, NY-7 E to Bennington, VT-9 E to Wilmington, then VT-100 N to West Dover); not a routing-service result. VT-9 over Hogback Mountain can be slow in winter.

airports.basis: Estimate from typical routing (NY-7 E to Bennington, VT-9 E to Wilmington, VT-100 N); not a routing-service result.
